Name: St Martin’s Walk Car Park
Coord_Precision: building (OSM way/156705537 'st martin's walk' car park)
Short_Description: The town’s largest council car park, behind St Martin’s Walk shopping centre, with separate long-stay and short-stay areas plus Blue Badge, parent-and-toddler and electric-vehicle bays.
Opening_Hours_Note: Pay 8am–6pm Monday to Saturday; Sundays and bank holidays are free (Mole Valley District Council).
Source: Mole Valley District Council, Car Parks and Charges (https://www.molevalley.gov.uk/parking-roads-transport/car-parks-charges/)
